sources.title: Aurora Forecasting - Microsoft Research
sources.snippet: A flexible 3D foundation model of the atmosphere. Aurora, developed by a team of Microsoft researchers, is a cutting-edge AI foundation model that can extract valuable insights from vast amounts of atmospheric data. This 1.3 billion parameter model excels at a wide range of prediction tasks, even in data-sparse regions or extreme weather scenarios. Aurora […]

sources.snippet: Aurora 1.5 adds 22 more variables, hourly temporal resolution, and probabilistic ensemble forecasting to the Aurora foundation model, making it more useful for real-world weather, climate, and energy applications.
